pm25.label: Particulate Matter (PM2.5)
pm25.description: Fine inhalable atmospheric particles with diameters that are generally 2.5 micrometers and smaller.

aod.label: Aerosol Optical Depth
aod.description: Measure of light extinction by atmospheric aerosol particles (dust, smoke, haze) across the atmospheric column.

rain_mm.label: Monthly Rainfall
rain_mm.description: Total monthly accumulated precipitation at the city coordinate.

no2.label: Nitrogen Dioxide Column
no2.description: Tropospheric nitrogen dioxide vertical column density, an indicator of combustion and vehicular/industrial emissions.
